coverage.coverage_note: Reported TWICE — all elites and solvent elites only — so the 0.33x/1x/3x mule-cost sweep moves a number instead of silently emptying cells. Ruin is a penalty plus a flag, never a deletion.
coverage.search_claim: MAP-Elites optimisation at 10.4 evaluations per occupied cell — below the >=25 budget, so selection pressure is weaker than intended and the coverage trend carries less weight.

distinctness.caveat: At low evaluation counts many elites have sparse or empty attribution distributions, so the merge is conservative -- it under-merges rather than over-merges, and the pre-merge count is the more honest read until the archive is well-populated.
distinctness.note: Cells whose elites are not separable above the JS threshold in detector-attribution space are MERGED, so the post-merge count can only fall. A diversity number that can go DOWN when validated is the only kind worth reporting.

note: The headline diversity integer is the POST-MERGE occupied-cell count. The type-legal string-space size (from `make grammar`) is subordinate and never the headline. This report can print below target, and the number it prints is what ships.

observable_delta.note: A slot whose values all produce the same observable-delta is credited with moving nothing distinguishable. MONETISATION is expected to be near-zero here, and that is the honest reason it is not allowed to inflate the diversity headline.
observable_delta.status: NOT MEASURED — no code path populates Elite.observable_delta
observable_delta.unmeasured_caveat: The per-slot observable-delta instrument is DECLARED BUT NOT WIRED: nothing assigns Elite.observable_delta, so there is no measurement to report. Previously this printed 0.0000 per slot, which reads as 'measured, and every slot moves nothing'. It is reported as unmeasured instead.

projection_tables.depth_source: derived from the plan's stage count, NOT a grammar slot
projection_tables.evasion_axis: identity mapping — an EVASION mutation is always cell-crossing
